quote.text: The strong do what they can and the weak suffer what they must.
quote.author: Thucydides, History of the Peloponnesian War, Book V, the Melian Dialogue

stories.headline: Anthropic’s Nasdaq float sells 6 per cent, keeps the vote
stories.dek: The price of 825 million shares, ranged at 70 to 78 dollars, was still unannounced at 5am Singapore time on 19 November; at the midpoint the company is valued near 968 billion dollars, and seven founders keep 50.1 per cent of the vote through a single share.

stories.headline: Amateur seismologists hear distant quakes on home Raspberry Shakes
stories.dek: The Panama-made Raspberry Shake, launched on Kickstarter in July 2016, now feeds a public network of 2,000-plus stations; its own country’s M7.7 earthquake struck on 9 October.

stories.headline: South Korea lets Mounjaro bought in Japan through customs
stories.dek: From 12 November travellers may carry home three months of Eli Lilly’s weight-loss injection; that day one Japanese clinic platform filled all 384 consultation slots to 19 November.

stories.headline: Xi greets Trump in Shenzhen before three-power summit
stories.dek: Xi saw Putin first on 18 November; today Trump meets both, then Putin alone, with the trade truce running out on 10 January 2027.

stories.headline: MAS sets PayNow upgrade dates running to 2028
stories.dek: The roadmap published on 18 November promises one QR code for every banking app from 2027 and higher limits for government payments in late 2027; rules on refunds and scams arrive in stages through 2028.

stories.headline: Technics SL-1200GR2 holds its speed to 0.004 per cent
stories.dek: Hi-Fi News measured the £1,799 SL-1200GR2’s peak wow at 0.01 per cent; Linn sells a £32,200 Klimax LP12, and a £4,550 motor upgrade on its own price list.

stories.headline: Motorola opens orders for its US$1,599 GrapheneOS-ready phone
stories.dek: Pre-orders for the Signature 27 open in the United States on 19 November and it ships on 26 November, sold unlocked with seven years of updates — but GrapheneOS, the privacy system that makes it news, has yet to list it as supported.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Algorithme Du Temps
stories.headline: Algorithme du Temps makes a seconds hand run backwards
stories.dek: Nadim Elgarhy’s Rêveries des Secondes, shown on 18 November, reverses for 19 per cent of every five minutes yet hits twelve on the minute — 40 pieces, about 16,800 francs.

stories.headline: Lionsgate’s Reaping prequel opens chasing a US$100m weekend
stories.dek: The prequel reaches Singapore today and 3,900 North American theatres on 20 November; the studio itself projects US$85 million.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Year 8 In England
stories.headline: Anna Freud study finds a quarter of England’s Year 8s struggling
stories.dek: Jess Deighton, who leads the government study of 7,811 children aged 12 and 13, set out its lessons on 14 November: 94 per cent content with life, 25 per cent over a screening line for probable disorder.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Fed Minutes
stories.headline: Federal Reserve minutes flag AI debt and hedge-fund leverage as risks
stories.dek: Published on 18 November, the Federal Reserve’s minutes of its 27–28 October meeting name borrowed money at hedge funds and the debt behind AI data centres as the system’s weak points.

stories.headline: A year’s training leaves one in five Finnish over-70s unimproved
stories.dek: Onni Hämäläinen’s team followed 288 Finns over 70 through a year of training; publicised on 16 November, it ties gains to strength-session attendance.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Messiah, Sumo And A Card Game
stories.headline: Bach Collegium Japan brings Messiah to Singapore
stories.dek: Seats from S$88 for Masato Suzuki’s performances on 26 and 27 December; in Tokyo, the Yu-Gi-Oh! creator’s art show opens 12 December, and January sumo goes on sale 5 December.
